f8386ae2f9b71746ef498a3cfee64fc575446da7.translatedText: We can understand a digital image as a matrix of a certain size, where the value of each element in the matrix represents the brightness or darkness of each pixel in the image\. Therefore, finding the maximum value in the matrix is equivalent to finding the pixel with the highest grayscale value in the image, and computing the mean is equivalent to computing the average grayscale of the image pixels, which can be used to represent the overall brightness or darkness of the image\. Thus, statistical operations on matrix data also have certain significance and role for image pixels\. OpenCV 4 integrates many functions for statistics, such as finding the maximum value, minimum value, mean, and standard deviation of image pixels\. The relevant functions for these features are described in detail below\.
